title: 헌법재판소 정보화심의위원회 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00425:20201224:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on the Administrative Organization of the Constitutional Court) <No. 425, December 24, 2020>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2021.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Rules) (1) through (7) Omitted.
(8) Part of the Rules on the Constitutional Court Informatization Promotion Committee shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (2), "Director General of Information Resources" shall be replaced with "Director General of Adjudication Information."
In Article 8 (2), "Director General of Information Resources" shall be replaced with "Director General of Adjudication Information."
